description: Get net creations of US spot Bitcoin ETFs in BTC against newly mined bitcoin. Windows: the last full week (Monday to Sunday), 30 days, year to date and since launch (11 Jan 2024), each with ETF net BTC, mined BTC and their ratio (null when ETFs had net outflows). Also the number of consecutive full weeks with ETF demand above new supply and the last 12 weeks. ETF BTC is the daily USD net flow divided by the volume-weighted bitcoin price of that day; mined BTC is the block subsidy times blocks between midnights UTC.
name: get_btc_etf_vs_miners
title: Bitcoin ETFs vs Miners
